what: On hover the text is erased from one end (default left) by 101% over .5s cubic in-out, and at the erasing line, every frame, 3 × (100 × that frame’s progress + 1) particles (radius 1~3px, text color) are rotated in random directions and fly at ±2px/frame while swaying on a 50px up-down sine, fading over (length × 60 − 20 ~ +20) frames. Once fully erased the text re-forms from blur 10px and transparent in .4s, and for 1s after that, hovering again does not retrigger it

options.direction: Side that gets erased: left·right·top·bottom, default left
options.amount: Grain amount coefficient, default 3 — use 20 for large email text
options.pad: Margin (px) by which the grain canvas overflows the text, default 60
options.rest: Time after finishing before input is accepted again (ms), default 1000
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to erase (required) — the interaction is applied to the whole element

note: Mouse only (hover: hover) — on touch and reduced motion the text is left as is, not wrapped

from.where: index.html .id-contact__email, social link, footer cookie text (original particle-disintegrate)
